title: JsonSchemaLockFile
description: Records what a folder of generated code was generated from: the folder's whole generation specification, the hash of every schema it was generated from, and the files written. A later run into the folder adds its schemas to that specification and regenerates the whole set as one program, so the folder never holds types wired to a program that another run overwrote; a run that changes nothing is skipped.

engine.description: The code generation engine the folder was generated with.

codeGenerationMode.description: The code generation mode the folder was generated with.

specification.description: The folder's effective generation specification: every schema generated into the folder with its settings, and the options they share. Local schema and additional file paths are relative to the folder, with forward slashes; outputPath is not recorded.

schemaHashes.description: For each local schema file and additional file in the specification, keyed as recorded there, the SHA-256 hash of the RFC 8785 canonical form of its content.

generatedFiles.description: The files the last run wrote, relative to the folder with forward slashes, in ordinal order.
